title: Projection/exchange coherence for compact support
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, let $u:T\to U$ be a separated finite-type morphism of schemes, and let $v:U'\to U$ be arbitrary [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Form the Cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with $T'=T\times_UU'$, $w:T'\to T$ and $u':T'\to U'$. Supply a compactification $c=(j,p)$, with $j:T\hookrightarrow\overline T$ a quasi-compact open immersion and $p:\overline T\to U$ proper, $pj=u$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and its base change $c'=(j',p')$, with $\bar w:\overline T'=\overline T\times_UU'\to\overline T$. No separatedness of $T,U,U'$ over a field or of $v$ is assumed.

Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(V_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ of constant discrete module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], the operations and adjunctions $a^*\dashv Ra_*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], derived tensor [def-weil-derived-tensor], and exact extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Put $F_u^c=Rp_*j_!$ and $F_{u'}^{c'}=Rp'_*j'_!$. Define $E_u^c:v^*F_u^c\to F_{u'}^{c'}w^*$ as proper unit--square--counit exchange followed by $Rp'_*$ of $\bar w^*j_!\cong j'_!w^*$. Define $\operatorname{PF}_{u,N,P}^c:F_u^cN\otimes^LP\to F_u^c(N\otimes^Lu^*P)$ as the counit-defined proper projection transformation followed by $Rp_*$ of $j_!N\otimes^Lp^*P\cong j_!(N\otimes^Lj^*p^*P)$ and $j^*p^*\cong u^*$. These are precisely the finite-level chosen-compactification formulas written in [def-exchange-projection], here with arbitrary $v$.

For all $N\in D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ and $P\in D(U_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$, these specified maps satisfy
$$
E_u^c(N\otimes^Lu^*P)\circ v^*\operatorname{PF}_{u,N,P}^c
=\operatorname{PF}_{u',w^*N,v^*P}^{c'}\circ(E_u^c(N)\otimes1),
$$
after inserting the canonical pullback/tensor and pullback-composition comparisons on the source and target. The equality is natural in $N,P$ and asserts no invertibility of exchange or projection.

proof.text: The canonical underived pullback-composition square is monoidal: the composition comparisons are conjugates of the monoidal direct-image composition comparisons. Lift its tensor compatibility to the derived category with Functor.map_leftDerivedTensorComparison_comp_eq_of_iso. Identify the lifted square with leftDerivedUpperStarSquareIso by the definitions of derived composition and congruence. This gives square_tensor for the actual fixed-coefficient pullbacks.

proof.text: The proper direct-image exchange is, by definition, the mate of that canonical pullback square. Its counit equation is mateEquiv_counit. Apply Adjunction.rightAdjointProjectionMap_mate using square_tensor to obtain proper_coherence. This is a formal adjunction calculation and does not invert proper exchange or projection.

proof.text: For an open square, iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv identifies the underived direct-image base-change map with the horizontal mate of the pullback square. The unit equation for its conjugate is open_mate_unit. Lift it with Adjunction.mapDerivedCategoryAdjunction_mate and transport along the canonical exact/left-derived pullback isomorphisms. Transport tensor along the same isomorphisms by the proved elementary mixed_tensor calculation. The unit and tensor equations are exactly the hypotheses of Adjunction.projectionMap_mate. Apply it, then cancel the open projection and pullback tensor isomorphisms, obtaining derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekProjectionIso_inv_baseChange.

proof.text: Pullback associativity identifies the comparisons for the two squares of a compactification with the comparison for their composite square. This is compactification_square, proved by the adopted pullback associativity theorem and cancellation. Naturality combines it with the open projection/base-change identity to give open_coherence, including the specified compactification comparison.

proof.text: Expand the published projection map into proper projection, inverse open projection and the compactification comparison. Expand the published exchange into proper exchange and inverse open base change. Naturality moves the open projection and compactification comparison through proper exchange. Substitute proper_coherence, use naturality of proper projection in its first input, and substitute open_coherence. Functoriality and associativity give pasting. Specialize to the supplied Cartesian base-changed compactification and finite modules. The coefficient braiding instance paths are definitionally equal; rewrite their explicit equality before specialization to avoid unfolding derived functors. All maps and hypotheses are unchanged.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NZ-f5c86268b (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, all 13 cited statements, the maps of def-exchange-projection (the two lem-cbc nodes, the ambient ringed exchange, the mate definition), the parent lem-pur-co-smooth-composition, unit sk-prop-cohsm, the main-20261015 blueprint sentence 'same calculation after arbitrary base change gives (3)', and Stacks sites-cohomology 0E48 (l.13715), 0GL1 (l.4578) and sites-modules 0E8I (l.4051). The statement is well typed: finite commutative Lambda, arbitrary schemes, arbitrary v, a supplied compactification over S=U. E^c and PF^c are exactly def-exchange-projection's Ex_{*,p} followed by Rp'_*(beta), and pi_p followed by Rp_*(gamma). The beta and gamma maps point the same way as in the open normalization node, and the cbc nodes are stated for arbitrary finite Lambda. The coefficient sheaves (Cont(pi0,Lambda))^# and the constant sheaf agree for finite discrete Lambda, so no master condensed category is identified with another. The item asserts no invertibility and weakens nothing. Small cases pass: N or P zero, T empty, v=id, j=id (exactly the ringed exchange/tensor coherence) and p=id (exactly the step-3 open identity); nothing needs flatness. Step 2 applies the ringed coherence (any commutative square; Ex is the mate of theta; pi is the adjunct of (eps x 1)t) with f=p, g=v, E=j_!N. Step 3: the source is iso to an object j'_!(...); full faithfulness plus the unit reduces the identity to its j'^* restriction, where b and gamma are identities. The remaining compatibility of mu with pullback composition is checked termwise on K-flat flat-term representatives; the composition node states its termwise form and the tensor-pullback node's construction is termwise. This is borderline but acceptable: lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso covers only A_{E,n}. Steps 4-5: naturality of e along gamma, then steps 3 and 2, then naturality of pi in its first input (projection-mate-exact). I checked each displayed line. No cycle (BFS), all cited nodes exist and none is merged, no new nodes, no SGA. I checked lem-sf-pf-compactification-pasting, prop-sf-pf-coherence, lem-sf-pf-open-factor-coherence and lem-sf-proper-open-projection-mate: none duplicates the item. All five declared tool_uses are accepted: tensor-pullback, pro-etale pullback composition, open tensor normalization, ringed exchange/tensor coherence and projection-mate naturality. No fixes.
